author: neatcleaver
body:
I find Mammon in monuments fairly often

Also T9 and I can take them out, I usually run monuments as a Nyx with a Nagamaki for the AoE. The weapon skill also pierces defence quite well

Summoner should be able to take down Mammon unless you get unlucky with getting hit. In a dungeon with an already max summons up it should be easy, but monuments I don't use summoner at all right now because it's more unreliable especially when there's multiple enemies up

Still 10 in one day is a lot lol. I see one in maybe every 3rd monument on average. Sometimes multiple in one
